about_short_description.short_description: Saudi Lime Industries is a distributor of limestone products and their derivatives such as quick lime, dololime, blocks, and bricks.

product.name: Limestone
product.description: A natural mineral product with high purity (97%-99%) used in various industrial and non-industrial applications.

product.name: Quicklime (Calcium Oxide)
product.description: A chemical compound used in multiple industries, produced by heating limestone to create calcium oxide.

product.name: Dolomite
product.description: A sedimentary rock used as a raw material in various industrial applications.

product.name: Hydrated Dolomite (Dololime)
product.description: A processed form of dolomite combined with water, used in multiple industrial applications.

product.name: Hydrated Lime
product.description: A product made by slaking quicklime with water, used in various industrial processes.

product.name: Limestone Blocks and Bricks
product.description: Building materials made from limestone, used in construction for architectural and structural purposes.
